name: Borscht
desc: A vibrant red soup dish. Once the broth is ready, various ingredients are added in batches and slow-simmered until their flavors meld. A spoonful of sour cream is often added just before serving. With every sip, a steady warmth spreads through the body, enough to keep the bitter cold at bay.

value.text: Somewhat decreases the rate of Sheer Cold accumulation for all party members for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
